Description (facts): Laboratory result of one patient e-mailed by the reception to a wrongly typed address, as an unprotected attachment. The unrelated recipient reported it and opened the file.
Consequences and measures taken: Recipient deleted the e-mail and confirmed in writing at 11:50. Password-protection and address read-back rules restated.
Risk (low / medium / high) and reasoning: Medium: health data seen by an unrelated person; mitigated by the recipient's prompt confirmation.
Authority (yes / no, date; reasoning): Yes, 9 Apr 2027, 14:30 (5 h 15 min after awareness)

Description (facts): Doctor's laptop left on a train. Disk encrypted, screen locked. No clinical data stored on the device: it is in the cloud application. Not recovered.
Patients: up to ~40 names on invoices
Consequences and measures taken: All sessions ended, passwords changed, device blocked, police report filed.
Risk (low / medium / high) and reasoning: Low: encrypted disk, strong password, no clinical data on the device; reasoning recorded.
